opener_concept: Sliding a counter on a game board from (2, 3): 3 squares right and 1 up lands it on (5, 4). Two common-sense addition boxes; the reveal names it as a translation and introduces the column vector (3 over 1). SVG game-board grid with the counter and a dashed slide arrow.
notes: Fresh-solved all 20 problems (8 bronze / 7 silver / 5 gold) from display text: every stored solution (all index 0) was mathematically correct across translations, reflections in the axes and y=x, rotations 90 clockwise/anticlockwise and 180 about the origin, and enlargements with fractional and negative scale factors and area SF-squared scaling.
